def parent_fd(path):

                          dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = new

    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)

    except FileNotFoundError:

            os.close(parent)
        return row
    except BaseException:

        raise

        row.update(exists=True, device=s.st_dev, inode=s.st_ino, nlink=s.st_nlink,
                   mode=oct(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)), uid=s.st_uid, gid=s.st_gid,
                   bytes=s.st_size, allocated=s.st_blocks * 512)

                    READ_BYTES += len(raw)
                    require(count <= s.st_size and READ_BYTES <= 32 * 1024 * 1024, 'hash byte cap')
                    digest.update(raw)

                row.update(type='file', sha256=digest.hexdigest())
            finally:
                os.close(fd)

            fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=parent)
            try:
